svg.text: CONTROL VALVE, FO / FC = FAIL OPEN / CLOSED
SIS SHUT-OFF VALVE, SOLENOID, FAIL CLOSED
SERVICE CODES: P PROCESS HYDROCARBON · LS LP STEAM
CW COOLING WATER · DR DRAIN · COND. STEAM CONDENSATE
LINE NO. = SIZE - SERVICE - NUMBER (SIZES TBC, NOTE 2)
LSLL-202: CLOSE XV-209 & XV-202; TIC-208, TIC-202 MAN 0 %.
LSHH-203 / HS-ESD: AS LSLL-202, PLUS CLOSE XV-201,
* ARMED ONLY WHEN SIS IS IN RUN (HEAT ON).
** ONLY WITH FV-201 > 20 % AND XV-201 OPEN.
RESET BLOCKED WHILE A CAUSE IS PRESENT. RE-OPEN XV-209
TIC-208 & TIC-202 MAN ≤ 10 %, HV-209 & HV-202 OPEN.
1. DESIGN BASIS: DEPROPANIZER COLUMN VER 1 OTS MODEL, DESIGN CASE. PRESSURES MPa g. MW 44.1 / 58.1 kg/kmol ASSUMED.
FEED 60 m³/h ≈ 31.8 t/h (634 kmol/h, 57 mol-% C3), -1 → 75 °C IN E-201 (67 % VAPOUR), TRAY 18 OF 27.
PROPANE 32.1 m³/h ≈ 16.1 t/h; BOTTOMS 27.8 m³/h ≈ 15.6 t/h; VENT 72 Nm³/h. MASS CLOSURE +0.14 %.
2. LINE SIZES PRELIMINARY FROM VELOCITY (LIQUID 1-2.5 m/s, VAPOUR ≤ 10 m/s) - TBC BY HYDRAULIC CALCULATION.
3. PRESSURE INSTRUMENTS C/W ROOT AND TEST VALVES; PUMP CASING VENTS/DRAINS; TYP., NOT SHOWN.
4. XV-201, XV-202, XV-209 FAIL CLOSED, OPERATED BY THE SIS (SIGNALS NOT SHOWN). HV-202, HV-209 ARE MANUAL BLOCKS.
5. FAIL POSITIONS: FV-201, TV-202, TV-208, LV-202, LV-203 FC; FV-204 (REFLUX) AND PV-210 (VENT) FO.
6. LT-202 / LS-202 AND LT-203 / LS-203 ON SEPARATE NOZZLES; PT-211 INDEPENDENT OF PT-210 (PIC-210).
7. P-201A MOTOR, P-201B STEAM TURBINE (DIVERSE DRIVE); P-202A/B MOTOR. SPARE AUTO-STARTS (SCHEDULE).
8. TIC-227 (TRAY 27) CAN CASCADE THE FIC-204 SET POINT (CAS); NORMALLY MAN, FIC-204 ON ITS OWN SET POINT. SIGNAL NOT SHOWN.
9. PDI-212 COLUMN DIFFERENTIAL PRESSURE, TAPS ABOVE TRAY 27 AND IN THE SUMP VAPOUR SPACE (FLOODING INDICATOR).
10. PSV-201 4L6, SET 1.80 MPa g: CW FAILURE 40 852 kg/h (API L ORIFICE); FIRE CASE TBC; 5.9 % OPERATING MARGIN - HOLD.
11. V-201 SHOWN WITHOUT OVERPRESSURE PROTECTION IN THE OTS SCOPE - PSV REQUIRED, HOLD.
12. PSHH ON C-201 OVERHEAD TO TRIP REBOILER STEAM BEFORE PSV LIFT RECOMMENDED - HOLD (NOT IN OTS SCOPE).
13. DCS INDICATORS (TI, PI, FI, AI) IMPLY A FIELD TRANSMITTER; AI-219 C4+ IN PROPANE, AI-220 C3 IN BOTTOMS.
14. ALARM SET POINTS: SEE WORKBOOK (ALARM TABLE); TRIP SET POINTS: INTERLOCK SCHEDULE.
15. TRAYS NUMBERED FROM THE BOTTOM; ONLY FEED, CONTROL AND INDICATION TRAYS ARE LABELLED.
16. DESIGN CASE (REV A): NO V-201 LEVEL CONTROL, LT-201 LOCAL. REV B: LI-201 ON DCS, LAL/LAH-201, FAL-201 ON FIC-201.
REV C: LIC-201 SETS THE FIC-201 SET POINT (CASCADE, RSP). BOTH ARE UPGRADES SELECTED IN THE OTS.
LIC-201 CASCADE; OTS SCREEN DWG (USED IN DECKS)
